106200.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies Trail Into the Jungle.

east.description: To the east lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106200.description:
The footpath begins here at the village's edge, a ribbon of packed red
clay worn smooth by bare feet and walking sticks. Thatch roofs crowd
close under the broad leaves, and the smell of cookfires and wet earth
hangs in the heat. A trail breaks off north into the jungle, while the
footpath runs on east between the huts.

106201.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies A Hut of Rough Timber.

east.description: To the east lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

west.description: To the west lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106201.description:
A junction of footpaths in the middle of the village, the clay worn into
shallow bowls by countless steps. A rack of drying fish stands to one
side, and an old cooking pot sits cold on three stones. Thatch eaves
overhang the paths and keep them shaded. A rough timber hut stands
north, and the footpath goes east, south and west.

106202.name: A Hut of Rough Timber

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106202.description:
Unlike the clay huts around it, this one is raised of unplaned timber,
the planks rough and silvery with age. A table stands in the middle with
a bench along each side, and split firewood is stacked neatly against
the wall. The floor is boards, a rarity here, and creaks underfoot. The
door opens south.

106203.name: A Modest Hut Made From Thatch and Mud

east.description: To the east lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106203.description:
A modest hut of mud and thatch, with a floor of beaten earth strewn with
fresh rushes. A small loom stands unfinished in one corner, the cloth a
bright zigzag of red and ochre. Light slants in through the doorway and
a smoke hole above the hearth. The door opens east to the footpath.

106204.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

west.description: To the west lies A Modest Hut Made From Thatch and Mud.

106204.description:
The footpath runs between low clay walls, shaded by a fig tree whose
roots have heaved the ground into ridges. Its fallen fruit lies split
and sweet-smelling in the dust. A small shrine of three stones sits in
the crook of the roots, with a pinch of rice laid on top. The path goes
north and south, and a modest hut stands west.

106205.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

east.description: To the east lies Chicken Coop.

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106205.description:
A stretch of footpath lined with waist-high fences of woven cane,
scratched and dusty. The clay underfoot is pocked with tiny three-toed
prints. A smell of grain and dung drifts out from the east. The footpath
leads north and south, and a coop stands east.

106206.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

east.description: To the east lies Pig Pen.

south.description: To the south lies A Hut Made from Clay and Thatch.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Clay Hut.

106206.description:
The southern end of the footpath, where it frays into a muddy court
between three buildings. A rain barrel stands under the eaves, brimming
and green. A cracked clay oven squats in the shade, its mouth black with
soot. A hut stands south, a smaller one west, a pig pen east, and the
footpath goes back north.

106207.name: A Small Clay Hut

east.description: To the east lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106207.description:
A tiny hut, little more than a single round room, its clay walls ringed
with a pattern of finger-drawn spirals. A sleeping mat takes up half the
floor, and a clay lamp sits in a niche beside it. The place is spotless
and smells of smoke and lemon grass. The only door opens east to the
footpath.

106208.name: A Hut Made from Clay and Thatch

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106208.description:
A solid hut with walls two hands thick, built to keep out both heat and
rain. A pair of hand-woven mats lie on the floor, and a cookpot hangs
over a cold firepit. Charms of shell and feather are knotted over the
door. The door looks north onto the footpath.

106209.name: Pig Pen

west.description: To the west lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106209.description:
A trodden yard of black mud, walled by a rail fence and shaded by a
lean-to roof of palm. A trough carved from a log stands beside a heap of
rotten fruit and kitchen scraps. The smell is rich and warm, and the mud
is churned into deep wallows. The pen opens only west, to the footpath.

106210.name: Chicken Coop

west.description: To the west lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106210.description:
A low shed of cane and thatch, with perches of split bamboo and rows of
nesting boxes lined with straw. Feathers drift in the corners, and the
floor is thick with dry droppings and spilled grain. Light falls in thin
stripes through the wall slats. The only way out is west to the
footpath.

106211.name: A Small Thatch Hut

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106211.description:
A cramped hut, built low against the sun, with a roof of palm thatch
that nearly touches your head. Inside are a bed of reeds, a shelf of
tiny carved figures, and a water pot with a gourd dipper. The air is
warm and smells of straw. A narrow door opens north to the footpath.

106212.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

east.description: To the east lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Thatch Hut.

west.description: To the west lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106212.description:
A bend in the footpath where two lanes join, the clay rutted by years of
carrying. A cracked clay bell hangs from a pole beside the way, rung to
call the village together. Washing lines sag between the huts, hung with
grey linen bandages drying in the heat. The path goes north toward a
garden, east and west along the huts, and a small thatch hut stands
south.

106213.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies Garden.

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106213.description:
The footpath narrows to a strip of packed earth between two fences of
woven cane. Over the fences hang the heavy vines of gourds and the
heart-shaped leaves of yams. The earth smells rich and freshly watered.
A garden opens north, and the path runs back south.

106214.name: Garden

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106214.description:
A large garden, laid out in neat raised rows and watered by little
channels dug by hand. Beans climb poles, squash sprawl across the earth,
and tall plantains lean over it all with their ragged green banners.
Someone has mounded the soil carefully around every plant. A scarecrow
of sticks and rags stands guard, and the only way out is south to the
footpath.

106215.name: A Tidy Hut

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106215.description:
Everything in this hut has its place: pots hung by size on pegs, a broom
leaning in its corner, a mat rolled square beside the hearth. The clay
walls are patched with fresh mud and pressed with the marks of many
careful hands. A single window, hung with a reed screen, lets in a dim
gold light. The door opens south to the footpath.

106216.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies A Tidy Hut.

east.description: To the east lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

south.description: To the south lies Leper Memorial.

west.description: To the west lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106216.description:
The footpath meets another track at a crossing, with small gardens of
beans and gourds fenced with split cane. A water jar stands on a flat
stone by the way, its lid weighted with a pebble. Smoke curls from a
cookfire out of sight. A tidy hut stands north, a quiet memorial lies
south, and the path goes east and west.

106217.name: Leper Memorial

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106217.description:
A small bare court lies behind the huts, closed in by a low wall of
piled stones. Rows of flat river stones stand upright in the earth, each
scratched with a name and a handful of years. Fresh flowers lie before
several, orange and red, wilting in the heat. A hush hangs here, and the
only path leads back north.

106218.name: A Well-kept Hut Made From Clay

north.description: To the north lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106218.description:
A neat little hut, its clay walls smoothed and limewashed, its dirt
floor swept to a polish. A bed of woven reeds lies under a clean
blanket, and a shelf holds a few carved wooden bowls set in a careful
row. Bunches of dried herbs hang from the rafters, scenting the warm
air. The door opens north onto the footpath.

106219.name: Footpath Through Leper's Village

north.description: To the north lies Chapel.

east.description: To the east lies Trail Into the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies A Well-kept Hut Made From Clay.

west.description: To the west lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106219.description:
The footpath widens into a small square before the chapel, its clay
swept clean each morning with palm brooms. Flat stones ring a patch of
beaten earth where the villagers gather to talk and mend. The chapel's
thatched porch stands north, a well-kept clay hut lies south, and the
footpath runs on west. A trail leaves east for the jungle.

106220.name: Chapel

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106220.description:
The chapel is a single long room of whitewashed clay, cool after the
heat outside, with a floor of swept earth. Rows of plain wooden benches
face a low altar draped in faded blue cloth. Small clay lamps burn on
the sills, and a carved holy sign hangs on the far wall, rubbed smooth
by the touch of many hands. The door is south, onto the footpath.

106221.name: Trail Into the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

106221.description:
Beyond the last hut the jungle begins, and a trail leaves the village
here into the green. Banana plants lean over the track, their ragged
leaves rattling in a rare breath of wind. The ground is trampled to a
hard dark crust by many passings. The trail runs north into the jungle,
and the footpath leads back west into the village.

106222.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Into the Jungle.

106222.description:
The trail is broad and well trodden here, striped with sun where the
trees stand back. Prints of bare feet and bundled loads mark the packed
earth, going to and from the village. The scent of woodsmoke is faint on
the damp air. The trail goes north, and runs back south toward the huts.

106223.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies A Leaf Shrouded Section of the Jungle.

106223.description:
The trail runs along a slight rise, the ground firmer here and grey with
dry leaf-litter. Tall trees stand wide apart, and the air is a little
cooler under their spreading limbs. Small paths of beaten earth branch
from it into the leaves. The trail goes north and south, and a faint
track leads west into a leafy thicket.

106224.name: Trail Through the Jungle

east.description: To the east lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106224.description:
A bend in the trail, where a spring seeps across the path and turns the
ground to a sucking black mud. Someone has laid half-rotted planks
across the worst of it, now slick and green. The leaves hang low and
trail wet fingers over your shoulders. The trail turns east beyond the
mud, and goes back south.

106225.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106225.description:
The trail dips here into a hollow thick with giant ferns, their fronds
arching overhead like the ribs of a great roof. The air is still and
sweltering, and your clothes cling damply to you. A thin steady drip
falls from leaf to leaf with a soft ticking. The path leads north, and
back west around the bend.

106226.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106226.description:
Broad, flat stones have been set into the trail here, long ago, now sunk
and tilted and furred with moss. Whoever laid them meant the path to
last, but the jungle has taken it back. Strange pale flowers push up
between the cracks. The old way runs north and south.

106227.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Pond.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106227.description:
The trail ends in a muddy slope that leads down to the water, trampled
by many tracks. Rushes rise at the margin, and the air above the pond
shimmers with heat and rising vapour. The smell of the water is warm and
faintly of eggs. Water lies north, and the trail goes back south.

106228.name: Pond

north.description: To the north lies Pond.

east.description: To the east lies Pond.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106228.description:
You wade in water to your waist, warm and cloudy, with a bottom of soft
grey mud. Steam curls in lazy threads from the surface, and the reeds
nearby are brown at the tips. A shallow shore curves up to the south,
where the trail comes down. Pond water stretches on north and east.

106229.name: Pond

east.description: To the east lies Pond.

south.description: To the south lies Pond.

down.description: To the down lies Narrow Gulley.

106229.description:
The pond narrows here and the water runs deeper and quicker, tugging at
your legs with a gentle current. At the bottom of the pool a gap in the
rocks swallows the flow, and the water slides away downward through it.
The stones around are slick and warm, stained rust-red. Pond water lies
east and south, and the outflow leads down into a gully.

106230.name: Pond

north.description: To the north lies Pond.

west.description: To the west lies Pond.

106230.description:
A shallow arm of the pond, warm as bathwater and no deeper than your
knees. The bottom is paved with smooth round pebbles, and sunlight
flickers across them in nets of gold. On the bank, a wall of cane reeds
stands thick and rattling. The water goes on north and west.

106231.name: Pond

south.description: To the south lies Pond.

west.description: To the west lies Pond.

106231.description:
The far corner of the pond, where the water lies shallow and still
beneath a screen of drooping branches. The mud is thick with rotting
leaves, and bubbles rise from it now and then to burst with a faint
stink. Pale lilies float in the gloom, closed against the dimness. The
pond runs south and west from here.

106232.name: Trail Into the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Footpath Through Leper's Village.

west.description: To the west lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

106232.description:
Here the village ends and the green wall begins. The footpath narrows to
a trail as ferns and glossy leaves close in on both sides, dripping in
the heavy air. Behind you to the south the huts show through a haze of
smoke. The trail climbs on north into the jungle, and a more trodden
track leads off west.

106233.name: Well-used Trail Through the Jungle

east.description: To the east lies Trail Into the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

106233.description:
The trail leaves the main track and bends south, worn hard and wide by
years of use. Footprints have cut a shallow trench in the earth, edged
with trodden grass. Ferns arch overhead and drip. The trail turns east
toward the village, and leads on south.

106234.name: Well-used Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

106234.description:
The well-used trail runs along a ridge, with the ground falling away
into dense jungle on either side. Stones along the edges are polished by
passing feet, and a snapped branch has been tied back with a vine. The
leaves are lighter here, and the heat less close. The trail goes north
and south.

106235.name: Well-used Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

106235.description:
A crooked turn in the trail, where a flat boulder makes a seat for tired
walkers, its top rubbed smooth. Bundles of dried grass and old rope are
heaped beside it. The jungle thins slightly, and a small breath of air
stirs the leaves. The trail runs north and west.

106236.name: Well-used Trail Through the Jungle

east.description: To the east lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies Lookout Post.

106236.description:
The trail climbs a short rise toward a platform of lashed poles above
the trees. Rungs of cut sapling are tied to its supports with strips of
hide. Down in the shade below, the ground is packed hard from standing
feet. The trail runs east, and leads west to the lookout post.

106237.name: Lookout Post

east.description: To the east lies Well-used Trail Through the Jungle.

106237.description:
A platform of lashed timber looks out over the jungle roof, shaded by a
patchwork of palm leaves. From here the green sea of treetops rolls away
to a rim of blue water, and beyond it the volcano stands smoking against
the sky. A watcher's stool and a signal horn on a peg mark the post. The
only way down is east along the trail.

106238.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Into the Jungle.

106238.description:
Roots like knuckled fingers cross the trail, slick with moisture, and
you pick your footing carefully. Overhead the canopy shuts out most of
the sky, leaving a green and stifling twilight loud with insects.
Somewhere a harsh call rises and is answered from far off. The trail
goes on north, and runs back south toward the village.

106239.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

east.description: To the east lies In Thick Bracken.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106239.description:
A tall stand of bracken has been trampled flat at the trail's edge where
something heavy pushes through on its way to water. The air is thick
enough to drink, and sweat runs freely down your back. Fallen blossoms
rot in the mud, sweet and sickly. The trail runs north and south, and a
rough gap in the ferns opens east into thick bracken.

106240.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106240.description:
The trail runs straight here for a stretch, a narrow aisle between
trunks wrapped in creeper. Yellow beams of light fall through the leaves
and make the steam rising from the mud look like smoke. A line of ants
crosses the path in a glossy red thread, busy and unconcerned. North and
south the trail goes on under the dripping leaves.

106241.name: Trail Through the Jungle

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106241.description:
The trail bends sharply here, turning back on itself around a mossy
boulder as big as a hut. Orchids hang from the branches overhead, pale
and waxy, dripping water in slow beads. The ground is soft underfoot and
holds the prints of bare feet going both ways. The trail leads south,
and bends west past the boulder.

106242.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

east.description: To the east lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106242.description:
A rotting log lies half across the trail, furred with green moss and
riddled with beetle holes. You step over it, and the damp of the wood
soaks through your boots. Frogs trill in the undergrowth, falling silent
as you pass and starting again behind. The trail turns east toward the
bend and runs on north.

106243.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106243.description:
The jungle presses closer here, and vines hang across the trail like the
rigging of a wrecked ship. You push them aside with your arm, and they
spring back wet and clinging. High above, the canopy shakes and rains
leaves on something unseen. The trail goes on north and south.

106244.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106244.description:
A thin grey haze lies along the ground here, and the first faint smell
of sulphur reaches you on the hot air. Through a gap in the leaves you
glimpse a dark slope above the treetops, a plume of smoke leaning over
it. The mud on the trail is gritty with fine pale dust. The trail runs
north toward the smell and south toward the village.

106245.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Trail Through the Jungle.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106245.description:
The trail is wider and harder here, trodden by many feet and marked with
the ruts of dragged loads. Cut stumps stand at the edges where brush has
been cleared back, their tops weathered silver. The jungle noise dulls,
and a hint of woodsmoke drifts down from ahead. North the trail leads on
toward an encampment, and south it winds back into the green.

106246.name: Trail Through the Jungle

north.description: To the north lies Encampment.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies At a Tepid Pond's Shore.

106246.description:
The trail opens a little at a trampled junction, with the smell of smoke
and beaten earth strong on the air. A rough path forks west down toward
a pond, its edge glinting through the reeds. North, a clearing shows
between the trunks, bare and ringed with notched stakes that mark a
camp's boundary. The trail runs back south into the jungle.

106247.name: At a Tepid Pond's Shore

east.description: To the east lies Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies A Tepid Pond.

106247.description:
A muddy bank slopes down to the edge of a pond, its surface warm and
still and dusted with fallen petals. Reeds stand in clumps at the
margin, and the mud is pocked with deep prints where beasts come to
drink. A faint mineral smell rises off the water, as if the earth
beneath it were warm. The pond lies west, and the trail is east.

106248.name: A Tepid Pond

east.description: To the east lies At a Tepid Pond's Shore.

106248.description:
Warm water laps at your thighs, cloudy with silt and tepid as a bath
drawn long ago. Thin curls of vapour drift over the surface, and the
bottom is soft mud that grips each step. Lily pads and broken reed stems
turn slowly on the faint current of a hidden spring. The only dry ground
is back east on the shore.

106249.name: Encampment

north.description: To the north lies Encampment.

south.description: To the south lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106249.description:
The jungle gives way to a hard-packed clearing at the edge of a camp,
ringed with sharpened stakes and strings of dried gourds that rattle in
the heat. Ash-grey handprints are smeared on the nearest posts. Trampled
earth and old fire pits show where people have lived hard. The camp runs
on north, and the trail leads away south into the jungle.

106250.name: Encampment

north.description: To the north lies Open Dirt Area.

east.description: To the east lies Dirt Area.

south.description: To the south lies Encampment.

west.description: To the west lies Cliff's Edge.

106250.description:
This is the heart of the encampment, a broad circle of beaten earth
around a fire pit heaped with grey ash. Lean-to shelters of hide and
palm crowd the margins, hung with drying strips of meat. A faint tang of
salt comes from the west, where the ground ends at a cliff. Paths lead
off north and east, and the way south goes back toward the trail.

106251.name: Open Dirt Area

north.description: To the north lies The Base of the Volcano.

east.description: To the east lies Community Hut.

south.description: To the south lies Encampment.

106251.description:
A wide stretch of bare dirt, swept and trampled until it shines like old
leather. To the north the ground begins to rise toward the foot of the
volcano, black and brooding under its plume. Carved poles stand in a
ragged row, each topped with a grinning mask of baked clay. A low
community hut squats to the east, and the camp lies south.

106252.name: Dirt Area

east.description: To the east lies Grubby Animal Pen.

south.description: To the south lies Community Gathering Area.

west.description: To the west lies Encampment.

106252.description:
Hard-packed earth stretches between the huts, scattered with bones,
nutshells and bits of woven cord. A tall drying rack leans in the
middle, hung with pale strips of hide. The stink of the animal pen is
strong on the air from the east. The camp's heart lies west, and a wider
space opens south.

106253.name: Community Gathering Area

north.description: To the north lies Dirt Area.

106253.description:
A round clearing of pounded earth, ringed with split logs set on end as
seats. In its middle a circle of blackened stones holds the remains of a
great fire, and the ground around it is scuffed by dancing feet. Scraps
of coloured cloth and feathers hang from the surrounding poles. The only
path leads north to the dirt area.

106254.name: Grubby Animal Pen

west.description: To the west lies Dirt Area.

106254.description:
A rough fence of lashed poles holds in a patch of churned mud and wet
straw. A trough hewn from a hollow log stands half-full of scummy water,
humming with flies. The stench is thick and warm, and the ground sucks
at your feet. The only way out is west, back to the dirt of the camp.

106255.name: Community Hut

west.description: To the west lies Open Dirt Area.

106255.description:
Inside, the hut is low and smoky, its roof of palm thatch blackened by
years of cookfires. Sleeping mats are rolled against the walls, and
baskets of dried roots hang from the rafters. A shallow hearth of river
stones holds a bed of dull coals. The doorway opens west onto the dirt
of the camp.

106256.name: The House of Death

west.description: To the west lies The Base of the Volcano.

106256.description:
A low house of black stone and bone-white timber, windowless and thick
with the smell of old smoke and bitter herbs. Shelves of shaped clay
jars line the walls, each sealed with wax and marked with a daubed sign.
Mats of woven palm lie in rows on the floor, stained dark by what has
rested there. The only way out is back west into the daylight.

106257.name: The Base of the Volcano

east.description: To the east lies The House of Death.

south.description: To the south lies Open Dirt Area.

up.description: To the up lies Trail to the Volcano's Crest.

106257.description:
The jungle stops as if cut with a knife, and the slope of the volcano
rises ahead in a ramp of black cinder and broken rock. Thin threads of
steam seep from cracks in the ground, smelling of rotten eggs. Heat
shimmers off the stones, and the air tastes of ash. A rough trail climbs
the mountain's flank, a squat dark house stands east, and open ground
lies south.

106258.name: Trail to the Volcano's Crest

up.description: To the up lies Trail to the Volcano's Crest.

down.description: To the down lies The Base of the Volcano.

106258.description:
The trail climbs steeply over loose cinders that slide away under your
boots. Rope handholds, black with grease and soot, have been strung
along the steepest turns by someone long ago. Steam hisses from a crack
beside the path, and the rock is warm through your soles. Down leads
back to the foot of the mountain, and the climb goes up toward the
smoke.

106259.name: Trail to the Volcano's Crest

up.description: To the up lies Smoking Crest of the Volcano.

down.description: To the down lies Trail to the Volcano's Crest.

106259.description:
The slope steepens into a stair of broken black rock, and the heat grows
until the air wavers. A yellow crust of sulphur stains every crevice,
sharp and stinging in your nose. Ash drifts across the trail in soft
grey waves, filling the footprints of those who climbed before. Above
you the smoke rolls thicker, and below the path drops back down the
mountain.

106260.name: Smoking Crest of the Volcano

down.description: To the down lies Trail to the Volcano's Crest.

106260.description:
You stand on the ragged lip of the volcano, where the whole island falls
away green and hazy beneath you. Ahead the crater yawns, a pit of orange
glow and drifting smoke, and the roar of it fills your ears. The ground
is hot and glassy, split by cracks that breathe a flame-coloured light.
Wind tugs at your clothes, heavy with sulphur, and the only way down is
the trail behind.

106261.name: Cliff's Edge

south.description: To the south lies Cliff's Edge.

106261.description:
The cliff top ends here against a wall of thorny scrub that has grown
over the path, leaving no way further. Out beyond the edge the sea
shimmers pale green over shallows, and far below it breaks white against
dark rocks. A weathered post leans at the brink with a frayed rope still
knotted to it. The only way back is south along the edge.

106262.name: Cliff's Edge

north.description: To the north lies Cliff's Edge.

east.description: To the east lies Encampment.

south.description: To the south lies Cliff's Edge.

106262.description:
The ground ends here in a crumbling lip of red rock, and the sea spreads
out below, bright and endless. A hot wind rises up the face, smelling of
salt and weed, tugging at hair and cloak. Far down, surf hisses over
hidden rocks. The edge runs on north and south, and a way leads east
into the camp.

106263.name: Cliff's Edge

north.description: To the north lies Cliff's Edge.

106263.description:
Here the cliff edge bends over a sheer drop, and a narrow ledge of rock
slants down along the face. Old footholds have been chipped into the
stone, polished by climbing hands and feet. Below, waves slap at the
base of the island with a hollow boom. The edge runs back north, and the
ledge leads down the cliff.

106264.name: Cliff

up.description: To the up lies Cliff's Edge.

down.description: To the down lies White Sand Beach.

106264.description:
You cling to the face of the cliff on a ledge no wider than a plank, the
rock hot against your palms. Ropes of creeper hang beside you and offer
a doubtful grip. Spray from the waves wets your face, and far below
white sand shows at the foot of the island. The cliff top is up above,
and the climb continues down to the sand.

106268.name: Narrow Gulley

east.description: To the east lies Narrow Gully.

106268.description:
The pond's outflow trickles down a narrow cleft in the rock, and you
slide down after it onto wet stone. The walls are close enough to touch
on both sides, hung with ferns and dripping moss. The sky is a thin
ribbon far above. The gulley continues east, and a climb leads up to the
pond.

106269.name: Narrow Gully

west.description: To the west lies Narrow Gulley.

down.description: To the down lies Narrow Gully.

106269.description:
The gully tilts steeply here, and the stream falls over a lip of stone
in a thin bright ribbon. The walls are slick, striped with orange and
green where minerals and algae have stained them. Loose pebbles clatter
away down the slope at each step. The gully turns back west, and drops
away down toward the sound of the sea.

106270.name: Narrow Gully

up.description: To the up lies Narrow Gully.

down.description: To the down lies White Sand Beach.

106270.description:
The walls fall away at last, and the gully opens above a slope of sand
and shell. The smell of the sea is strong, and the sound of surf comes
up out of the dark below. A fence of lashed stakes, half rotted, leans
across the way, with a gap broken through it. The gully climbs back up,
and the way down reaches the white sand.

106275.name: In Thick Bracken

east.description: To the east lies A Tangle of Vines.

west.description: To the west lies Trail Through the Jungle.

106275.description:
Bracken rises over your head, a dense sea of green fronds that closes
behind you the moment you pass. The light is dim and underwater-green,
and the ground springs softly with rotted leaves. Burrs and seeds cling
to your clothing, and the damp sticks them fast. A way through leads
east into a tangle of vines, and west back to the trail.

106276.name: A Tangle of Vines

south.description: To the south lies Near an Old, Wet, Fallen Tree.

west.description: To the west lies In Thick Bracken.

106276.description:
Vines as thick as your wrist hang in loops and coils from every limb,
knotted together into a net that you must duck and climb through. Some
bear spiny pods, others red trumpet flowers heavy with scent. Water
drips constantly, and the footing is a mat of slippery stems. You can
squeeze on south, or push back west into the bracken.

106277.name: Near an Old, Wet, Fallen Tree

north.description: To the north lies A Tangle of Vines.

south.description: To the south lies Outside a Hollow Tree.

106277.description:
The trunk of a giant has come down here and lies across the ground,
black with wet and thick with shelf fungus the colour of old cream. Its
roots, torn up in a great disc of earth, stand taller than a man.
Sunlight reaches the forest floor through the gap it left in the canopy,
and young saplings crowd toward it. North the vines close in, and a path
winds south.

106278.name: Through a Tangle of Jungle Brush

east.description: To the east lies Near a Large Tree.

west.description: To the west lies Outside a Hollow Tree.

106278.description:
You force your way through a snarl of brush, thorny and wet, that
snatches at your sleeves with every step. Broad leaves slap your face
and shed their water down your neck. The ground underfoot is a hidden
tangle of roots, and the light is a dull green. A large tree looms ahead
to the east, and the hollow tree stands behind you to the west.

106279.name: Near a Large Tree

north.description: To the north lies Through a Growth of Tall Weeds.

south.description: To the south lies Branch Clustered Area.

west.description: To the west lies Through a Tangle of Jungle Brush.

106279.description:
A huge tree stands here, its trunk spread at the base into buttress
roots that form small walls and alcoves in the shadow. Lianas climb it
in spirals up into the dark of the canopy. The earth between the roots
is bare and scratched with old claw marks. Ways lead north through tall
weeds, south into a cluster of branches, and back west through the
brush.

106280.name: Through a Growth of Tall Weeds

north.description: To the north lies Near a Large Hole.

south.description: To the south lies Near a Large Tree.

106280.description:
Razor-edged grass and tall weeds stand taller than your head, nodding
together in the still air. Their seed-heads shed a fine dust that makes
you sneeze, and every stem is slick with dew. A path of sorts has been
broken through by a heavy body pushing back and forth. The weeds thin to
the north toward a hole in the ground, and open south at a large tree.

106281.name: Branch Clustered Area

north.description: To the north lies Near a Large Tree.

east.description: To the east lies A Leaf Shrouded Section of the Jungle.

106281.description:
Broken branches lie in heaps on the ground and hang in clusters
overhead, snapped and left by some storm that tore through the jungle
long ago. New shoots sprout everywhere from the fallen wood. The footing
is bad, with brittle twigs cracking at every step and loose leaf-litter
hiding holes. A large tree rises north, and the leaves thicken toward
the east.

106282.name: Near a Large Hole

east.description: To the east lies In a Lion's Den.

south.description: To the south lies Through a Growth of Tall Weeds.

106282.description:
The ground drops away here in a wide, ragged hole where the roots of a
fallen tree once stood, and its lip is trodden smooth. A rank, musky
smell comes from the east, heavy and old. Bones, picked clean, lie
scattered in the dirt around the edge. The weeds lie south, and a low
den opens east.

106283.name: Outside a Hollow Tree

north.description: To the north lies Near an Old, Wet, Fallen Tree.

east.description: To the east lies Through a Tangle of Jungle Brush.

south.description: To the south lies Inside a Hollow Tree.

106283.description:
A great tree rises here, its trunk split by a tall dark opening at the
base where the heartwood has rotted away. Strips of bark hang loose
around the gap, and the ground before it is worn into a smooth patch of
bare soil. The air that breathes out of the opening smells of damp wood
and old leaves. The tree's inner chamber lies south, with paths leading
north and east.

106284.name: Inside a Hollow Tree

north.description: To the north lies Outside a Hollow Tree.

106284.description:
You stand inside the tree, in a round chamber of living wood whose walls
are dark, ridged and faintly warm. The roof is lost in a spiral of old
rot and tiny roots that drip like candle wax. Dry leaves lie deep on the
floor, and the air is close and smells of mould. Dim light comes from
the opening to the north.

106285.name: In a Lion's Den

west.description: To the west lies Near a Large Hole.

106285.description:
The den is a scoop of dry earth under a ledge of tangled roots, floored
with trampled grass and dust. The smell here is overpowering, musk and
old blood, and bones lie in drifts against the walls. Raking scratches
score the roots where claws have been sharpened. The only way out is
west, toward the large hole.

106286.name: A Leaf Shrouded Section of the Jungle

east.description: To the east lies Trail Through the Jungle.

west.description: To the west lies Branch Clustered Area.

106286.description:
Great leaves hang in curtains around you, each as broad as a shield and
veined in dark green and purple. They hide the sky entirely, and the
light that filters through is thick and green as pond water. Your
footsteps are swallowed by the soft, wet ground. Back west the branches
pile up in clusters, and a trail leads east.

644900.name: leper villager man woman
644900.long_desc: A leper villager goes about the day's work with slow, patient care.
644900.description:
A villager in a clean, mended robe, hands wrapped in linen against the
sores of the sickness. Their eyes are tired but steady, and they greet a
stranger with quiet courtesy.

644901.name: boar jungle tusker
644901.long_desc: A bristling jungle boar roots through the leaf-litter, tusks stained red with clay.
644901.description:
A heavy, black-bristled boar with a ridge of coarse hair along its
spine. Its small eyes glint with ill temper, and its tusks are yellow
and scarred.

644902.name: tribesman ashen warrior hunter
644902.long_desc: An ashen tribesman in a grey-smeared hide kilt watches the camp, spear in hand.
644902.description:
A lean hunter striped from brow to chest with grey volcanic ash. He
keeps his obsidian-tipped spear low and ready, and he looks on outsiders
as trespassers.

644903.name: lion jungle maned great
644903.long_desc: A great maned lion lies watching from the shadow of the roots, tail twitching.
644903.description:
A huge tawny lion, scarred across the muzzle, with a dark mane matted
with burrs. It is lean and ill-tempered from guarding its den, and it
does not tolerate company.

644904.name: priest ash cultist ashen
644904.long_desc: An ash priest in a soot-black robe murmurs a low chant toward the smoking peak.
644904.description:
A gaunt cultist painted white with ash, with a necklace of blackened
teeth rattling on his chest. He calls the volcano his god, and he will
defend its slopes with fire-hardened staff and curses.

644905.name: gorrak death-speaker cultist shaman
644905.long_desc: Gorrak, the cultist Death-Speaker, crouches among the clay jars, muttering over a yellowed skull.
644905.description:
A bent, hollow-eyed old man in a robe sewn with knucklebones, his face
daubed half white and half black. He keeps the House of Death and
speaks, they say, with whatever answers from the mountain.

644906.name: fire spirit crest flame
644906.short_desc: the fire spirit of the crest
644906.long_desc: The fire spirit of the crest rises from the crater's glow, a shape of flame and drifting smoke.
644906.description:
A towering figure woven of orange flame and black smoke, with a face
that shifts like heat on stone. The ground cracks and glows where it
passes, and its voice is the roar of the mountain.

744900.name: boar tusk charm
744900.room_desc: A boar-tusk charm lies here on a frayed cord.
744900.description: A curved yellow tusk, drilled at the root and strung on a cord of braided fibre. Hunters on the island wear them for luck.

744901.name: obsidian spear tipped
744901.description: A straight spear of dark wood, bound at the head with sinew around a leaf of black volcanic glass. The edge is keen, and flaked by a patient hand.

744902.name: lion mane cloak
744902.room_desc: A lion-mane cloak lies in a heap here.
744902.description: A heavy cloak of tawny hide edged with a ruff of dark mane. It is hot in the jungle, but it turns a blow well.

744903.name: bone staff knucklebone
744903.room_desc: A knucklebone staff lies here, rattling faintly.
744903.description: A staff of pale wood strung with knucklebones and topped with a yellowed skull. It rattles when it swings and hits like a hammer.

744904.name: ember ring glowing
744904.room_desc: A ring of glowing ember lies here, warm to the eye.
744904.description: A band of black glass with a single coal-red spark trapped in its heart. It is warm against the finger and never cools.
